---
title: "Statistical formats (SPSS, Stata, SAS)"
engine: knitr
---

Files ending in `.sav`, `.zsav`, `.por` (SPSS), `.dta` (Stata), `.sas7bdat`, or
`.xpt` (SAS) are read with [haven](https://haven.tidyverse.org/). Labelled
columns are kept as-is; apply `haven::as_factor()` in your expression if you
want to convert them to factors.

## SPSS

### Reading

```{bash}
rush run -n 'head(df)' survey.sav
```

### Writing

```{bash}
rush run -n -o result.sav 'df' data.csv
```

## Stata

### Reading

```{bash}
rush run -n 'head(df)' data.dta
```

### Writing

```{bash}
rush run -n -o result.dta 'df' data.csv
```

## SAS

### Reading

```{bash}
rush run -n 'head(df)' data.sas7bdat
```

```{bash}
rush run -n 'head(df)' data.xpt
```

### Writing SAS transport

```{bash}
rush run -n -o result.xpt 'df' data.csv
```

## Converting between formats

```bash
rush convert -o output.sav data.csv
rush convert -o output.dta data.csv
rush convert -o output.xpt data.csv
```
